changelog:
v3.6.5 — Audio Dropout Diagnostics

Under the hood
• New: audio-loss detection. We now catch silent audio dropouts that used to slip past without a trace — the kind you get on Reelz and other channels where the ad breaks swap the audio stream mid-play. When it happens, the debug log now records exactly what changed (codec, channel count, sample rate) and how long the silence lasted.
• New: audio stall watchdog — if the AudioTrack stops advancing for more than 10 seconds while the stream is otherwise playing, we log it instead of failing silently.
• Better debug reports: any mid-stream audio format change, underrun, sink error, or renderer disable is now captured. Makes it possible to diagnose Reelz-style audio issues from a Send Debug Log.

No user-facing changes. Pure instrumentation.
